title: 60-Second Alliance Reset
concept: An emergency one-minute reset for when winning has replaced connecting. It’s designed to stop the damage fast, then book proper time to work it out. We’d keep it for emergencies, not every disagreement.
whenToUse: Use when you’re still in the room together, it’s turned into a fight to win, and you’re both willing to stop for one minute before a longer pause.
steps: Stop — quit trying to win or solve it.
Say it — “I want to connect, not fight.”
Touch (only if welcome) — a brief touch, nothing more.
Return — pick an exact time to keep talking.

phrases.text: I want to connect, not fight.
I’m stopping so we don’t do damage.

working: Mid-row over the holiday budget. A: “I’m stopping. I want to connect, not fight.” A puts a hand on B’s shoulder, if it’s welcome, and they both take three breaths. “Can we talk at 8pm?” B agrees. The budget waits till 8.
notWorking: Using the reset to shut the conversation down for good: “60-second reset — I’m done,” with no time to come back. That’s just walking away with extra steps. Always pair stopping with a real return time.
activity: Practise the five steps on a fake topic (“dishes”) three times while you’re both calm. Agree on the phrase you’ll actually use.
